Hello dear OWASP team,
Congratulations on the release of version 5 of ASVS.
After the final release of this version, our team started translating it into Persian, and 30% of the translation has been completed.
We are excited to contribute to this important project and look forward to sharing the translated version with the community.
We had previously mentioned this request in issue #2933.
If there are any specific guidelines or frameworks for the translation, please let us know.
Thank you!
